TomTom AmiGo: la astucia para mostrar radares junto a Google Maps

2026-07-11 Futura Team (Futura-Sciences) TomTom AmiGo, Google Maps, speed cameras, radars, Android, floating widget, navigation, France, Waze comparison
Read the source article

Quick summary

TomTom's free AmiGo app overlays a floating widget on Google Maps to display speed camera warnings and speed limits on Android — a legal workaround for French drivers that offers broader radar coverage than Waze.

Key takeaways

  • TomTom AmiGo is a free Android app that overlays a floating widget on Google Maps, displaying speed camera warnings and current speed limits without violating French law
  • In France, traditional radar detectors are illegal (article R.413-15), but apps indicating 'danger zones' are permitted — AmiGo operates within this framework
  • AmiGo distinguishes between fixed and mobile speed cameras, offering broader coverage than Waze which primarily focuses on fixed radars
  • The app is Android-only: iOS does not allow floating widgets over other apps, though AmiGo works standalone on iPhone and with Apple CarPlay
  • Reliability depends on community input, with less accurate warnings on rural roads where fewer users are active
